NOW, THEREFORE, I, BENIGN S. AQUINO III, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order the
Nayong Pilipino Foundation, Inc. to transfer its remaining land with an area of
22.3 hectares in Pasay City to the Manila International Airport Authority.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon publication in
a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 29th day of Septemh™the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Eleven.
By the President:
P/AQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
